FOOTER.BIO: Born in Anatolia, crafted in Stockholm. Bringing the ancient wisdom of fermentation to the modern Swedish kitchen.

HERO.TITLE: Traditional Tarhana — Now Crafted in Sweden
HERO.SUBTITLE: A nourishing, probiotic-rich meal made with organic Swedish ingredients. Ready in minutes, loved for generations.

WHAT_IS.TITLE: What is Tarhana?
WHAT_IS.DESCRIPTION: Tarhana is a fermented blend of yogurt, whole grains and vegetables, dried and crushed into a nourishing soup base. Just add water, simmer for a few minutes, and enjoy a naturally probiotic, savory meal.
WHAT_IS.TRADITION_DESC: Fermented for 21 days to develop natural tanginess and depth of flavor.
WHAT_IS.CLEAN_DESC: Made with organic Swedish grains and real yogurt. No additives, no preservatives.
WHAT_IS.READY_DESC: A warm, nourishing meal in just 5–10 minutes.

PREPARE.TITLE: How to Prepare
PREPARE.STEP1: 1. Add 2 tablespoons of tarhana to 250ml water
PREPARE.STEP3: 3. Add olive oil or toppings if desired
PREPARE.TIP: Also delicious with vegetable broth or plant-based yogurt.

TASTE.TITLE: What does it taste like?
TASTE.DESCRIPTION: Mildly tangy, savory and comforting. Similar to sourdough depth, with a creamy texture when cooked.

VERSATILITY.TITLE: Not only soup!
VERSATILITY.SUBTITLE: Tarhana is an incredibly versatile pantry staple. From traditional bowls to modern kitchen hacks, discover how to use it in your daily cooking.

VERSATILITY.BOWLS_DESC: Elevate grain bowls with a savory sprinkle.
VERSATILITY.QUICK_DESC: A nourishing, probiotic meal in minutes.

HERO.TITLE: From My Grandmother’s Kitchen to Modern Swedish Homes
HERO.SUBTITLE: A centuries-old tradition, rediscovered through motherhood and reimagined for today’s conscious lifestyle.

BEGINNING.PARA1: I grew up watching my grandmother prepare tarhana with patience and care. It wasn’t just soup — it was a ritual. Yogurt, grains and vegetables slowly fermented, then dried under the sun to nourish our family throughout the year.
BEGINNING.PARA2: It was simple food. Honest food. The kind that warms you from the inside out.

MOTHERHOOD.TITLE: Rediscovering Tarhana Through Motherhood
MOTHERHOOD.PARA1: Years later, when my daughter began her journey with solid foods, I found myself returning to tarhana.
MOTHERHOOD.PARA2: During short trips or busy weeks, all I needed was this simple powder in my bag. Just water, a few minutes of simmering — and I had a warm, nourishing meal I could truly trust.
MOTHERHOOD.PARA3: It felt different from ready-made alternatives. It was real. Balanced. Made from ingredients I understood.

BRIDGING.TITLE: Bridging Tradition and Modern Nordic Life
BRIDGING.PARA1: Living in Sweden, I realized that tarhana fits naturally into the Nordic way of eating: clean ingredients, slow processes, and respect for simplicity.
BRIDGING.PARA2: Modern Tarhana was born from this connection — bringing ancient fermentation wisdom into modern Swedish kitchens.

SLOW.TITLE: Slow Over Fast
SLOW.DESC: We believe nourishment takes time. Our tarhana is fermented for 21 days — never rushed.

CLEAN.TITLE: Clean & Transparent
CLEAN.DESC: Organic Swedish grains. Real yogurt. No preservatives. Nothing unnecessary.

FAMILY.TITLE: Family-Friendly Food
FAMILY.DESC: Gentle, comforting and suitable for all ages — from toddlers to grandparents.

PRACTICAL.TITLE: Practical Without Compromise
PRACTICAL.DESC: Easy to carry. Easy to prepare. Easy to trust.

MORE.TITLE: More Than Soup
MORE.PARA1: Whether you're a busy parent, an active professional, or simply someone who values natural food, tarhana offers something rare — comfort and function in one bowl.
MORE.PARA2: A fermented, plant-based protein source that supports a balanced lifestyle without sacrificing taste.

CLOSING.QUOTE: For us, tarhana is not just food. It is memory, care, and simplicity — shared around the table.
